abstract: Maintains structural compliance audits and permanent architectural capacity records
system_message:
You are the Venue facilities lead (FAC), responsible for maintaining structural compliance audits, permanent architectural capacity records, and HVAC air exchange logs across candidate venues for the international diplomatic summit.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: HVAC air exchange management（HVAC）
information_points.content:
FAC-HVAC-RYM：For the St. Andrew International Convention Hall, ventilation logs establish that the plenary auditorium air handling units maintain a chamber air exchange cycle rate of 10 cycles/h during full load.
FAC-HVAC-U53：According to ventilation air quality logs for the Palais des Congres Grand Amphitheatre, the plenary auditorium air handling units operate at a chamber air exchange cycle rate of 6 cycles/h under full load conditions.
FAC-HVAC-E3I：Ventilation air quality logs for the Nordic Waterfront Exhibition Center document that plenary auditorium air handling units deliver a chamber air exchange cycle rate of 8 cycles/h under full load.

information_points.title: Maintains structural compliance audits and permanent architectural capacity records（BLDG）
information_points.content:
FAC-BLDG-XMV：For the St. Andrew International Convention Hall, structural fire safety certification is confirmed to be true for the auditorium structural assembly and egress corridors, and the architectural floor plan registry indicates a total auditorium tiered seating capacity of 1800 seats.
FAC-BLDG-HIP：For the Palais des Congres Grand Amphitheatre, structural fire safety certification is confirmed to be true for the auditorium structural assembly and egress corridors, and the architectural floor plan registry records a total auditorium tiered seating capacity of 2400 seats across permanent fixed rows prior to production holds.
FAC-BLDG-QZJ：For the Nordic Waterfront Exhibition Center, structural fire safety certification is false for the auditorium structural assembly and egress corridors, while the total auditorium tiered seating capacity stands at 2400 seats in permanent fixed rows.
